d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap.. Bazaar jaisi chatpati Masala french fries ghar par banana chahte hain? Sirf 10-15 minute mein ye crispy snacks taiyaar ho jayenge.
Aaj main aapke saath ek aisi Aloo finger recipe share kar raha hu jo bilkul wahi taste degi jo aapko market mein milti hai. Isme na koi jhanjhat hai aur na hi lambi preparation, bas simple ingredients aur sahi technique ka istemal karenge.
